import ds.Fibonacci;

/*
 * Test class EvoAITest up from EvoSuite auto-generated template for clarity.
 */

interface UnitTest {}

@RunWith(EvoRunner.class)
@EvoRunnerParameters(mockJVMNonDeterminism = true, useVFS = true, useVNET = true, resetStaticState = true, useJEE = true)
@Category(UnitTest.class)
public class EvoAITest extends Fibonacci_ESTest_scaffolding {

    private static final int LARGE_INPUT = 1596;
    private static final int EXPECTED_FIB_LARGE = 1597594320;

    @Before
    public void setUp() {
        // Intentionally left blank: no shared mutable state to initialize for these unit tests.
    }

    @After
    public void tearDown() {
        // Intentionally left blank: no resources to clean up for these unit tests.
    }

    /**
     * test0: fibIter_withLargeInput_returnsExpected32BitValue
     * Requirement: REQ-FIB-001 - Fibonacci iteration correctness for integer inputs
     */
    @Test(timeout = 4000)
    public void test0() throws Throwable {
        // Given
        final int input = LARGE_INPUT;
        final int expected = EXPECTED_FIB_LARGE;

        // When
        int result = Fibonacci.fibIter(input);

        // Then: specific assertions with descriptive messages
        assertEquals("fibIter(1596) should return expected 32-bit integer value", expected, result);
        assertTrue("fibIter result should fit in Java int range", result <= Integer.MAX_VALUE && result >= Integer.MIN_VALUE);
    }

    /**
     * test1: constructFibonacci_instanceCreatedSuccessfully
     * Requirement: REQ-FIB-000 - Fibonacci object construction behavior
     */
    @Test(timeout = 4000)
    public void test1() throws Throwable {
        // Given / When
        Fibonacci fib = new Fibonacci();

        // Then: verify observable behavior via public API
        assertNotNull("Fibonacci instance should be created", fib);
        assertEquals("fibIter(0) should return 0", 0, Fibonacci.fibIter(0));
    }
}
